source: USDA NASS prices received (processing / dry beans) + BLS average price (grocery).
thesis: Frozen, dried, juice, and paste are often more transparent than a fresh carton because they store, processors report a $/ton, dry beans print monthly, and FCOJ has a futures pit. They are not the carton. A juice apple is not extra-fancy; paste is not a greenhouse cluster; FCOJ is not a navel.
disclaimer: NASS processing is usually a marketing year, national, all grades of processing fruit. BLS is a US grocery average, not a GTA invoice. AAFC is a destination ask. AMS shipping-point FOB is still the real fresh trade tape and is not scraped here.

Apples.read: Juice apples are a public $/ton. Dried snack slices are a private plant. Extra-fancy Honeycrisp is not either of those.

forms.label: Juice / peeler stock
forms.honest: NASS processing, marketing year. Culls and peelers — not extra-fancy.

forms.label: Dried slices
forms.honest: No public dried-apple tape. Snack plants quote privately.

Strawberries.read: IQF / jam berries print as NASS processing. A clamshell is a different desk. No public IQF FOB.

forms.label: IQF / processing
forms.honest: NASS processing cwt. The raw that goes into a freezer or jam kettle, not a Driscoll clamshell.

Grapes (Table).read: Crush / juice grapes print as NASS processing $/ton (wine and juice mashed together). Raisin plants do not print a separate monthly tape here.

forms.label: Juice / wine crush
forms.honest: NASS processing $/ton. Mostly California crush, not a Thompson seedless carton.

forms.label: Raisins
forms.honest: Raisin bargaining is a co-op. No monthly public raisin pit on this desk.

Peaches.read: Canning peaches are a public $/ton. Fresh extra-fancy is a short summer window.

forms.label: Canning / process
forms.honest: NASS processing $/ton. Cling canning stock, not a tree-ripe tray.

Pears.read: Bartlett process vs Anjou fresh. Processing prints yearly.

forms.label: Canning / process
forms.honest: NASS processing $/ton. Canners, not extra-fancy Anjou.

Tomatoes.read: California paste is the most transparent tomato tape after AMS fresh FOB. It is not a greenhouse cluster.

forms.label: Paste / dice plant
forms.honest: NASS processing $/ton (California paste). A 2025 marketing-year floor, not Nogales vine-ripe.

forms.label: Canned tomatoes
forms.honest: BLS used to print canned tomatoes; that grocery series is dead. Use paste farm-gate plus a plant quote.

Potatoes.read: Fry / chip stock prints as NASS processing. Frozen fries no longer have a BLS grocery average (ended 2005). Lamb Weston (LW) is the listed weather.

forms.label: Fry / chip stock
forms.honest: NASS processing cwt. Contract russets into a plant, not a 50-lb table bag.

forms.label: Frozen fries
forms.honest: BLS frozen-fry grocery average ended in 2005. The public weather is Lamb Weston, not a fry FOB.

Onions.read: Dehydrated onion is a real industrial market with no public pit. Fresh storage onions print NASS + AAFC.

forms.label: Dehydrated
forms.honest: Dehy plants (California / Idaho) quote privately. No NASS dehydrated series on this desk.

Broccoli.read: IQF florets are a plant quote. Fresh crowns print NASS + AAFC.

forms.label: IQF florets
forms.honest: No public IQF broccoli FOB. Frozen mixed-veg is a private packer.

Carrots.read: Juice / jumbo vs cello. Grimmway / Bolthouse are private.

forms.label: Jumbo / juice
forms.honest: No public carrot-juice tape. Two private firms dominate US fresh carrots.

Cucumbers.read: Pickle stock vs slicer vs English greenhouse — three businesses.

forms.label: Pickle stock
forms.honest: No current NASS pickle series on this desk. Brine plants quote privately.

Beans.read: Dry edible beans are one of the few produce substitutes with a real monthly public tape — storable, reported, comparable. Snap beans are a fresh carton.

forms.label: Dry edible
forms.honest: NASS dry-bean farm-gate, monthly. BLS grocery dried beans is the retail end. This is what transparent looks like.

Sweet Corn.read: Canned corn still prints a BLS grocery average. Fresh sweet corn is a short window.

forms.label: Canned corn
forms.honest: BLS canned corn, grocery average, monthly. Not a fresh ear, not a frozen cob.

forms.label: Frozen cut / cob
forms.honest: No public IQF sweet-corn FOB on this desk.

Oranges.read: Frozen concentrated orange juice is the only fruit with a real futures pit (OJ=F). Fresh navels are a carton. Do not mix them.

forms.label: Processing oranges
forms.honest: NASS on-tree equivalent $/box (~90 lb). Juice fruit, not a gift carton.

forms.label: FCOJ (frozen concentrate)
forms.honest: ICE FCOJ futures plus BLS frozen-concentrate grocery average. Not a fresh navel.

Plums.read: Prune / drying stock vs fresh plum. Processing prints yearly.

forms.label: Prune / drying stock
forms.honest: NASS plum processing $/ton. Not a fresh black plum lug.

Cherries.read: Tart cherries for pie/IQF print in $/lb. Sweet fresh is a short June desk.

forms.label: Tart / IQF / pie
forms.honest: NASS tart processing $/lb. Pie and IQF, not a Northwest sweet lug.

forms.label: Sweet brining / process
forms.honest: NASS sweet processing $/ton.

Lettuce.read: Fresh-cut kits are not frozen lettuce. There is no public IQF iceberg tape.

forms.label: Fresh-cut kit (not frozen)
forms.honest: Kits are a plant SKU (Taylor / Fresh Express, private). Frozen lettuce is a niche. Watch SYY, not a freezer print.

Bananas.read: Chips / puree are private. Fresh bananas are the only produce with a real world pink-sheet cousin — still not a pit.

forms.label: Chips / puree
forms.honest: Banana chips and puree are industrial quotes. Dole / Del Monte (DMC) are the listed weather.

Garlic.read: Dehydrated garlic is a large industrial market (China) with no clean public pit on this desk.

forms.label: Dehydrated
forms.honest: Dehy garlic is China industrial. No monthly USDA dehydrated series here.

Blueberries.read: IQF blueberries are a real trade. USDA does not print a clean monthly IQF FOB on this desk.

forms.label: IQF
forms.honest: IQF is a plant and import quote (Chile / Peru / GA). No NASS processing series pulled here.

defaultCrop.read: No listed frozen or dried public tape for this carton. IQF and dehy are plant quotes. Use fresh farm + AAFC wholesale, and do not pretend a freezer FOB exists.

forms.label: Frozen / IQF
forms.honest: No public IQF FOB for this item on the desk.

forms.label: Dried / dehydrated
forms.honest: No public dehydrated tape for this item on the desk.
